action_items: None — all functional criteria met. Optional: consider suppressing the two @twilio/voice-sdk 'AccessTokenInvalid (20101)' console errors on the auth page when the softphone token fetch fails (currently only logs; page & flow remain usable). Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: telephony.py is ~985 lines — several very long single-line handlers (e.g. lines 141, 175, 674). Readability would improve by extracting the credential-encryption and doc-shape logic into helpers. Not blocking.

In save_settings, if any credential field is submitted containing '•' but the key is NOT in old_creds it is silently dropped — this is the intended masking-round-trip behavior, but consider logging a warn when a bullet value hits a missing key so admins notice a mis-paste.
twilio_webhook uses `settings['credentials']['auth_token']` for signature validation; if verify_signatures is toggled on before creds are filled this will KeyError → 500. Consider guarding.
voice_settings docs are served through the frontend static route; ensure production build copies /app/frontend/public/docs/*.md into build/docs. Confirmed 200 in preview.
plivo_webhook does not persist the /input digits when node lookup fails (line 692 pushes digits only when call+digits — good) — but the empty-digits path is not tested.

server.py is now ~5337 lines — carryover from iteration 4: extract telephony wiring into its own router module (already partly in telephony.py; server.py just needs to drop the shim). Long file makes future edits risky.
